GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 400.192 (4 Nov 45) NR
(SCAPIN - 238)
5 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Report on Spectrographic Analytical Equipment in Japan.
1. The Japanese Government will report on the existence of all spectrographic analytical equipment in Japan proper as follows:
a. Description of model.
b. Condition.
c. Availability of technical operator.
d. Location in detail.
2. This report will be delivered written in English to the Mining and Geology Division, Natural Resources Section, GHQ, SCAP, within 15 days of the date of this directive by a representative of the Japanese Government familiar with the subject.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
